name: website-redesign
description: Redesign an existing website or web product — marketing sites, SaaS apps, dashboards, ecommerce, docs, public services — so it is better for its users and genuinely its own: framing by surface type and intensity, measured audit, research by problem, a direction derived from the brand, token and component systems, implementation in the existing stack, then scripted verification of renders, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), responsiveness, performance and truth-parity, critique and iteration.
